title: By 2 months, most babies make sounds other than crying
summary: The CDC 2-month language list says most babies make sounds other than crying.
body: Under language and communication, the CDC page for 2 months lists making sounds other than crying among what most babies do by that age. A separate line on the same list is reacting to loud sounds. This card is only the sound-making line. The heading on the page is what most babies do, which the CDC defines as 75 percent or more, so a quieter baby is not outside every normal path. The list is the United States checklist.

sources.title: Milestones by 2 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US federal page, public domain. Opened 2026-11-26. Reviewed date on the page is 16 May 2026. Supports the language milestone 'Makes sounds other than crying' under what most babies do by 2 months.
